newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sadia Concordia Jan-May sales up 13.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sadia Concordia Jan-May sales up 13.8 pct.

text.p: Brazilian meat producer Sadia Concordia S.A. said it posted sales of 634.6 million reais in the first five months, up 13.8 percent from 557.6 million reais in the same period last year.

A spokesman at Sadia Corcordia, a member of the Sadia food group, said domestic sales totalled 502.5 million reais while exports of chicken, turkey, pork and soy products accounted for 132.1 million reais.
Exports were up 96.6 percent while domestic sales rose 2.5 percent from the five-month period last year, he said.
May sales at the firm totalled 134 million reais, a 9.1 percent jump in sales revenue from the same month last year.
The spokesman said Frigobras, another member of the Sadia group, posted five-month sales of 452.5 million reais versus 384.9 million reais in the January-May 1996, a rise of 17.6 percent.
Exports at Frigobras rose 72.1 percent to 82.8 million reais while domestic sales rose 9.8 percent to 369.7 million reais in the five-month period versus January-May 1996, he said.
Meanwhile, sales at Sadia Oeste totalled 89.5 million reais, down 17.4 percent from 108.3 million reais from the same five-month period last year.
Sadia Oeste exports fell 64.2 percent to 4.9 million reais while domestic sales dropped 10.6 percent to 84.6 million reais.
Sadia Concordia, Frigobras and Sadia Oeste are the Sadia group's three publically traded firms.
